critique: The dynamically scrolling, skewed film strip serves as a striking structural anchor, beautifully layered over procedural canvas textures of drifting carmine strokes and animated gilded shards. However, the reliance on external, static image assets (`art.png` and `guineapig.png`) breaks the generative immersion; replacing these with natively coded, bioluminescent organic forms would greatly enhance both the technical novelty and the cyber-nature fusion.
